PER_SHAPE_FLOOR_DEPTH_TABLES.scope_warning: Filed July taxonomy medians post-date the stale June proof and include named July games; this fixed null is a requested retrospective comparator, not out-of-sample evidence.

SHAPE_TAXONOMY_BUILD1.signature_method_verbatim: per leg, T-minus axis normalized to the verified span [formation end -> bell]: forward-filled last-true-print path sampled at 17 points (leading value = post-formation open); features net/travel/maxstep/bigstep_share/early(first-quarter) net/late(last-quarter) net/reversals; families by stated rules in family() (rule order: SLEEPER, ROUND_TRIP/QUIET_WOBBLE if |net|<5, LATE_BREAK if last quarter >=70% of net, EARLY_SET if first quarter >=70% and flat after, ONE_STEP if one inter-sample step >=60% of net, GRIND_WOBBLE if >=4 reversals and travel>=2|net|, else DRIFT)

numerical_null_rules.called_family: exact family/category depth_below_open_c.med and floor_pos.med, never ALL fallback
numerical_null_rules.level: post-formation open minus median depth (negative depths preserved, not clipped)
numerical_null_rules.minutes_to_bell: (1 - median floor position) * verified span minutes; no gate clipping
numerical_null_rules.missing_category: STORE_SILENT; no cross-category or ALL borrowing
numerical_null_rules.numerical_scope: floor point/timing only; no fabricated full path or prediction band
numerical_null_rules.role_only_climber: zero depth as requested; no early-position scalar is stated in either cited file
numerical_null_rules.role_only_faller: the filed V52p category down-depth aggregate, full precision
numerical_null_rules.role_only_timing: STORE_SILENT: qualitative early/late is not a numeric role-only timing predictor

taxonomy_bench_choices.causal_family_adaptation: At a receipt only, normalize formation through the current gate into 17 samples; do not use or forward-fill into the unknown remainder. Realized labels use formation through bell.
taxonomy_bench_choices.direction: early/late shares are signed relative to net; reversals omit zero steps
taxonomy_bench_choices.flat_after: abs(net after first quarter) <= 2 cents; operator-authorized bench choice, not taxonomy law
taxonomy_bench_choices.quiet_wobble_prose_caveat: The inherited travel split does not mathematically guarantee the prose 5-cent band. quiet_wobble_prose_band_exception is exposed; no new cutoff is introduced.
taxonomy_bench_choices.sleeper: actual post-formation true-print count < category empirical p10; bench choice, not taxonomy law
taxonomy_bench_choices.small_net_branch: abs(net)<5: ROUND_TRIP if travel>=10; otherwise QUIET_WOBBLE; no extra band filter
